evidence.primaryPersona: platform operator reconciling long-running inference without guessing lifecycle state
evidence.reuseConvergence: reuses StatusBadge, ProgressBar, report-kit lifecycle colors, and theme tokens; no new component family
evidence.sourceTruth: strictly parsed AsyncInferenceOperationStatus values from the durable operation ledger
evidence.emptyFailureBehavior: the existing empty state is preserved; every persisted lifecycle state has an explicit label and an invalid state fails before rendering
evidence.aiBoundary: the surface reports durable provider lifecycle state and never infers completion or success from prose
evidence.accessibility: status has a textual label and progress uses the shared named progressbar rather than color alone
evidence.responsive: the existing horizontally scrollable table remains usable without introducing fixed-width status content
